value.title: NIST SP 800-63B - Memorized secret (password) guidance
value.snippet: The NIST SP 800-63B guidelines for memorized secrets provide recommendations for how to design and implement such authenticators. These guidelines include the following: * Memorized secrets should be at least 8 characters long and contain a mix of uppercase and lowercase letters, numbers, and symbols.

value.snippet: Accordingly, at LOA2, SP 800 - 63 -2 permitted the use of randomly generated PINs with 6 or more digits while requiring user-chosen memorized secrets to be a minimum of 8 characters long. As discussed above, the threat model being addressed with memorized secret length requirements includes rate-limited online attacks, but not offline attacks.
